written_at_utc: see file mtime and IRC post time
single_axis: training composition only: arm A = frozen M2 fits loaded; arm B = same teacher, 6 features, LightGBM PARAMS, 200 rounds, 12 execution-year folds and cutoffs, sign policy, integer ledger, trained on real matured row pairs plus an equal number of synthetic matured row pairs from the 60 training paths
parents_in_order: timing_lgbm_v1_results d9556ca9 (M2 fits + real M2 ledger)
code_reuse: copy the frozen functions of timing_lgbm_v1.py verbatim: fee, buy_cost, sell_proceeds, targets, validate_series, prepare_prices, features, year_folds, training_rows, fit_lgbm (PARAMS, NUM_ROUNDS), predict_model, traverse_dump, ledger_run, yearly_increments; the new module imports nothing from lightgbm beyond what timing_lgbm_v1 used; lightgbm 4.6.0 and numpy 2.2.6 required
arm_A_load: for each entry year 2015..2026 read models[year].model_string from the M2 results, verify model_string_sha256 and dump_sha256 against the stored values, rebuild lgb.Booster(model_str=...), and verify on the real path that every stored decision's predicted_contrast is reproduced within 1e-9 (preflight, 0 fits); the real M2 ledger figures are loaded from the same file, never recomputed

arm_B_rows.real: training_rows(O_real, C_adj_real, c_y) exactly as M2; n_real_pairs(y) = c_y - 20 - 199
arm_B_rows.synthetic_candidates: for path index p = 0..59 (train_000..train_059 in manifest order) and position j in range(199, c_y - 20): feature vector features(C_syn_p, j) (synthetic adjusted close = close) and targets(O_syn_p, j) from the path's own opens P = O[j+1], Q = O[j+21]; the position index uses the shared calendar labels, so maturity j + 21 <= c_y holds identically to the real rows
arm_B_rows.sampling: candidate order (p ascending, j ascending); idx = Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([20261106, 200, y]))).choice(n_candidates(y), size=n_real_pairs(y), replace=False); selected pairs sorted ascending by candidate index; each selected pair contributes both held states 0 and 1 with its two targets; unit weights
arm_B_rows.matrix_order: real rows first (M2 order) then synthetic rows (selected order); this order is frozen because LightGBM bin construction samples rows when n_rows > bin_construct_sample_cnt (not reached here: max rows ~22,000 < 200,000, so bins use all rows; order affects nothing but is still declared)
arm_B_rows.counts_example: 2015 fold: c = 3031, n_real_pairs 2812 -> 5,624 real rows + 5,624 synthetic rows = 11,248; 2026 fold: ~5,500 pairs -> ~22,000 rows
arm_B_rows.forbidden: no path id, split, seed, regime, h, jump or any hidden-sidecar value in X; the stage-2 code never opens hidden/*.npz; evaluation paths (check_*, test_*) never enter any training matrix (asserted by path id prefix)

fits: 12 (one per fold, arm B); FIT_CALLS counter asserted == 12 at the end

ledgers.real: 1: arm B on the real calendar 2014-12-30..2026-11-05 with the M2 decider (sign of predicted contrast with actual held state; keep on exactly 0)
ledgers.synthetic: for each of the 40 evaluation paths (check_000..019, test_000..019): arm A (loaded M2 models), arm B (mixed models), always-long (w = 1 at every decision) = 120; identical ledger_run with 10,000 won deposit per session, integer fee, O +-5 tick execution, decision indices and fold-year mapping by position exactly as the real ledger

reporting.real: arm B vs loaded M2 vs loaded R1: terminal post-cost PnL, drawdown on value minus deposits, exposure, entries/exits/maintenance, total costs, yearly increments (carried valuation caveat stated); per fold: n_real_rows, n_synthetic_rows, synthetic rows per training path (counts only), gain importance, residual variance ratio
reporting.synthetic: per evaluation path and arm: terminal post-cost PnL, drawdown, exposure, trades, costs; differences A - AL, B - AL, B - A; distributions (min, median, max, share positive) by split (check = known combinations, test = unseen combinations) and by each generator parameter value from the manifest; stated: synthetic results do not validate real edge and no setting is chosen from them
reporting.cost_labels: every PnL figure is ledger PnL after integer fees and the 5-tick spread; predicted contrasts are pre-cost quantities

resources.estimated_wall_seconds: under 120 (12 fits of <= 22k rows x 6 features, 121 ledgers of 2,907 sessions)

outputs: work/mixed_training_v1_20261106/mixed_training_v1_results.json written once with xb (contract v3 envelope: schema_version, artifact_id, ordered parent hashes, code sha, lightgbm/numpy versions, availability_status, decision_at/execution_not_before markers, units); 12 model strings + canonical dump hashes + reload parity; per-decision records for the real ledger; per-path ledger summaries (not per-session rows) for the 120 synthetic ledgers; runlog outside the output directory with before/after hashes
